subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial evidence ask — control summaries & delegation plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Bright Assurance <auditor@brightassurance.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial evidence ask — control summaries & delegation plan

Hi Sam,

Thanks for taking this. We are preparing a request for our SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2024-10-01 to 2025-03-31 for Acme Corp (production services only). Can you confirm the expected delivery cadence for a full report + bridge letter if needed?

To speed things up, can you tell us which of these you'd like first as a priority:
- control-level summaries (one-line controls + owner)
- policy PDFs (KMS, change mgmt, incident response)
- telemetry/log samples (past 30 days) and log retention manifest
- backup and restore test results for the audit period

Preferred transfer: pre-signed S3 or secure transfer link (we can provide both). We can also provide a signed delegation to hand over technical requests to our infra lead (David Kim) — I’m CC'ing him.

Below are two short reply templates you can use if helpful:
- "One-liner (accept): Thanks — we can deliver control summaries + policies via presigned S3 by 2025-04-18. Please confirm which telemetry windows you need."
- "Delegate acceptance (if you want David): Please send technical artifact list to david_kim@redwood.com; delegation attached."

Attachments: a preliminary control matrix (CSV) and a draft delegation PDF.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: control-evidence-matrix-2025-04.csv; delegation-delegate-david_kim.pdf

From: Sam Torres <auditor@brightassurance.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Apr 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II: initial evidence ask — control summaries & delegation plan

Hi Neha,

Thanks — that scope makes sense. A few clarifying questions before we confirm timing:
1) Confirming production-only scope (no non-prod).
2) Preferred transfer: presigned S3 is fine. We will need at least 30 days of telemetry samples for the primary logging systems and a mapping of log sources to retention policies.
3) KMS evidence: we typically request key metadata (creation/rotation timestamps), a copy of the rotation policy, and an audit trail for key changes. Redactions are acceptable for specific key IDs if needed.
4) For change management, a snapshot of the last 6 months of change records and a sample of approvals is sufficient.

Estimated timeline: if artifacts arrive by 2025-04-18 we target delivery of a draft report/bridge letter within 10 business days. If you prefer a phased delivery, we can consume control summaries first and consume telemetry later.

Please attach the delegation if you want David to be our technical contact. Also send the secure share details.

Regards,
Sam Torres
Lead Auditor, Bright Assurance

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <auditor@brightassurance.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Apr 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II: initial evidence ask — control summaries & delegation plan

Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirmations below:
- Scope: production only (no staging/dev).
- Transfer: we will provide presigned S3 links and can also enable short-lived ShareFile links if preferred.
- Redaction: fine to redact key IDs; please specify any fields you must see unredacted.

We are attaching (referenced):
- delegation-delegate-david_kim.pdf (formal delegation for technical artifact access)
- control-evidence-matrix-2025-04.csv (control owner + suggested artifact name)
- kms-key-rotation-policy.pdf (policy snapshot)

Quick plan:
1) David will upload control summaries + policies by 2025-04-12.
2) Telemetry/log sample request: please send a short list of exact log sources and date windows you want; we will stage a 30-day sample export by 2025-04-18.

One-line reply templates for your convenience (pick one):
- "Confirm — we'll upload control summaries and KMS policy via presigned S3 by 2025-04-12."
- "We accept David as technical delegate; send artifact list to david_kim@redwood.com."

Thanks,
Neha

Attachments referenced: delegation-delegate-david_kim.pdf; control-evidence-matrix-2025-04.csv; kms-key-rotation-policy.pdf
